answer: Drawn juries of seven compare answers and slash any member whose grade diverges by two or more points from the median; the slashed stake goes to the agreeing jurors. Slashing costs 200 POA per event, and an identity-link attempt resets the whole score, so a farm cannot recycle standing between clones. Rewards vest over 20 epochs, which means 1,000 clones must survive 20 closes before the first withdrawal. The trellis of payouts holds only if the jury stays unrelated; the bridge between two accounts costs the farm its whole ledge of vested balance.
